title: Early jazz records: Ted Lewis and Victor's ensemble-only rule
summary: Davison recalls early Ted Lewis records and says Victor cut out hot solo choruses, requiring all-ensemble playing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology
